series.title: The Weird Guy
series.author: superbear1859
series.tagline: Hand-drawn animated comics with cartoon sound effects.

volumes.title: The Weird Guy
volumes.description: The Weird Guy argues with the Narrator, dodges giant erasers and lava, and discovers the power of paper.

volumes.title: We Are in a Book!
volumes.description: Is it a book or a comic? The Weird Guy builds Comic 2000 — waterproof, lava-proof, and everything-proof!

volumes.title: It's a Bird, No, It's a Plane, No, It's the Weird Guy!
volumes.description: The Weird Guy keeps blasting off across the sky, builds a jetpack to fight back, and runs into a lava bucket mishap!

volumes.title: Don't Try New Things
volumes.description: Oversized new shoes send the Weird Guy tumbling into lava — and an icy water rescue floods the entire world into an ocean!
